reason: The text is Exodus 15, the Song of Moses sung at the Sea (Shirat Hayam). It is a song of praise and thanksgiving to Yahweh celebrating His military victory, divine power, and protection of Israel. The Hebrew people express devotion ('I will sing to Yahweh'), marvel at God's uniqueness ('Who is like You among the gods, O Yahweh?'), and celebrate their deliverance. There is no criticism of Yahweh or of the leadership of Moses. The entire passage is celebratory and reverential in tone.
